title: —HE ONCE HAD MEANT TO COME ON EARTH IN HEAVENLY GLORY BUT WE SINNED; AND THEN HE COULD NOT SAFELY VISIT US BUT WITH A SHROUDED MAJESTY AND A BEDIMMED RADIANCE FOR HE WAS GOD.
html_source:
Examine the Book of Genesis.

God walked among man (i.e. Adam and Eve) in the Garden of Eden, until both Adam and Eve disobeyed God’s only request—to not eat fruit from the Tree of the knowledge of Good and Evil.

God exiled the pair from Eden for their sin, which is where Stephen picks up with “we sinned; and then he could not safely visit us but with a shrouded majesty and a bedimmed radiance”.
